title: Other accounts
intro: Bring mail in from another email account, such as Gmail, iCloud, Yahoo or your internet provider's email, and send as it from here. Mail App checks each one every 5 minutes. Your mail is always left on the other account, so nothing changes there.
limit: This mailbox has {max} other accounts, the most it can have. Remove one to add another.
off: Other accounts are switched off on this Mail App. Ask your admin if you need them.
name: Your name on emails from it
namePlaceholder: Leave empty to use this mailbox's name
pop3Hint: POP3 only brings in new mail from now on.
catchUp: Also bring in the last 30 days
catchUpHint: Older mail is filed quietly in your Inbox, read or unread as it is there, without notifications.
sendAs: Send as this address from Mail App
sendAsHint: Emails go out through the account's own server, so they arrive properly signed. With IMAP, a copy also goes in its Sent folder.
label: Label for its mail
labelHint: Everything that comes in from it gets this label, so you can see where it came from. Leave empty for none.
connecting: Signing in to check it works…
added: {address} is connected. Its new mail will appear in your Inbox.
removeConfirm: Remove {address}? Mail already brought in stays here, and nothing changes at the other account.
statusOk: Checked at {when}. {count} brought in so far.
statusCatchingUp: Bringing in the last 30 days. {count} so far.
statusSlow: It has failed {failures} times in a row, so it's now checked once an hour. Fix the password or settings, then press Check now.
tooBig: {count} emails over 25 MB were left at the other account.
notInstant: Checked every 5 minutes, not instantly, which keeps it inside Cloudflare's included allowance.
failed: That didn't work. Please try again.
adminOffHint: While this is off, no accounts are checked and nobody can send as them. They stay listed, ready to switch back on.
